_readme: Add your own local ports here -- games you already have installed yourself, no "source" needed. Just point folder_name at the folder you created under Library/, put the game files there yourself, and it shows up like any other port. This file is never overwritten by a ports.json update, so your own additions always survive. The two examples below are DISABLED on purpose ("name"/"folder_name" set to null, which makes Ports Launcher skip them) -- copy one, fill in real values, and it becomes a real entry.

ports.instructions: Copy your game's files into Library/<folder_name> yourself, then set "name" and "folder_name" above to real values (folder_name must match the folder you created).
